title: Coconut Rice Pudding with Caramelized Apples
blurb: Creamy arborio rice cooked in coconut milk, topped with golden caramelized apple slices.
steps: Put the rice, coconut milk, water and caster sugar in a medium saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over a medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice is tender and the mixture is thick and creamy.
While the rice cooks, peel and core the apples, then cut them into thin slices.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over a medium-high heat, add the apple slices and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until they start to soften.
Sprinkle the brown sugar over the apples and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes, turning occasionally, until caramelized and golden.
Divide the rice pudding between four bowls and top each portion with the caramelized apples.
